summary: Inspected @tanstack/virtual-core scroll/anchor behavior, refined the MessageList virtualizer to gate scroll-follow with `anchorTo: shouldFollow ? 'end' : 'start'` plus `followOnAppend: shouldFollow`, updated follow helpers and CSS, added assertions that the virtual canvas height grows and no scroll-anchor sentinel is rendered, and verified the change with prettier, svelte-check, build, and passing tests.
decisions: Use `anchorTo: shouldFollow ? 'end' : 'start'` together with `followOnAppend: shouldFollow` so end-anchoring (and its competing scroll command) only activates while the user is following output, avoiding fights with user scrolling.

Add MessageList test assertions that the virtual canvas height reflects total content (e.g., '22000px') and that no `[data-ui="scroll-anchor"]` element is rendered, guarding the virtualization behavior.
errors: pnpm `check:loc` failed because three unrelated files (settings-parts/skills-library.css, resource-catalog.ts, settings-parts/layout.css) exceed the 300-line limit; unrelated to this change.

Vitest invocation `pnpm --filter @gizmo/app test --run <paths>` failed with 'No test files found'; resolved by running `pnpm --filter @gizmo/app exec vitest run <paths>` instead, after which both test files passed (4/4).
